summary: Analyzed ~50 sessions and identified 3 major uncovered failure patterns: (1) Dead-tool fixation (QA repeatedly tries npx every session), (2) Groundhog Day / duplicate work (QA re-scans same commits, re-reports same findings), (3) Cross-boundary violation (optimizer tries to edit other agents' files). Need to determine which is best suited for a new skill vs scenario vs already partially covered.

data.uncovered_patterns: dead-tool-fixation (no FM code), groundhog-day (no FM code), boundary-violation (partially covered by file-safety)
